description: This file defines the IdValidator class, which provides functionality to validate IDs against a regex pattern. It includes methods for creating validator instances and checking validity, with detailed reason messages for invalid IDs.

classes.name: IdValidator
classes.description: Immutable class responsible for validating an ID string against a regex pattern. Can produce reasons why validation failed.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new IdValidator with a given ID and regex pattern, throwing NullPointerException if regex is null.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the stored ID against the pattern, returning true if it matches; provides failure reason if not.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the reason for validation failure, if any.
